fact: At a UN Legal Identity Agenda webinar on 29 August 2023 the NPC civil registration director reported birth registration completeness (under 5) at 57% (MICS 2021) and death registration at 10%, and an operational readiness assessment (2021) that found registration processes predominantly manual and paper-based.
title: Building and Strengthening the National Digital Civil Registration System: Nigeria's Journey
publisher: National Population Commission / UN Legal Identity Agenda
